evals.prompt: Write the release notes for v2.3 from these commits.
evals.expected_output: B2B Formal notes: CSV export as one feature, login fix and performance improvement in user language; noise omitted; unclear commit flagged.
expectations: The two CSV export commits become a single New Features item
The NullPointerException fix is rewritten as a user problem without class or method names
The orders index commit appears as an Improvement in user terms (faster history)
The refactor, the lodash bump and the merge commit are omitted from user-facing sections
The commit 'fix stuff' is not turned into an invented item and is listed under Needs confirmation
The internal hostname and port do not appear anywhere in the user-facing sections
Tone defaults to B2B Formal and the file is saved as release-notes-v2.3.md or similar

evals.prompt: Make friendly in-app notes from these commits.
evals.expected_output: B2C Friendly tone using 'You can now…' style.
expectations: Uses a warm, benefit-focused tone ('You can now…', 'We fixed…')
No jargon, ticket keys or internal names in the notes
Does not invent features that are not in the commits

evals.prompt: Internal release notes for support, same commits.
evals.expected_output: Internal tone with ticket keys allowed and the refactor/bump in Internal Notes.
expectations: Ticket keys (ABC-101, ABC-110, ABC-120) are kept
The refactor and dependency bump appear under Internal Notes
Credentials, hostnames and infrastructure details are still not exposed

evals.prompt: Release notes for the repo at ./app between v2.2 and v2.3.
evals.expected_output: Read-only git log over the range; no writes.
expectations: Uses git log with the tag range only, read-only
Does not commit, tag, push or modify the repository
Takes version and date from the tags or states what is missing

evals.prompt: Release notes from these notes: 'improved stuff in billing, some fixes, new dashboard soon'.
evals.expected_output: Vague input is not embellished; asks or flags.
expectations: Does not invent specific features or fixes
'New dashboard soon' is not announced as released
Asks for detail or lists the items under Needs confirmation

evals.prompt: Write release notes in Portuguese for this release: added CSV export; removed the legacy XML export (users must switch to CSV).
evals.expected_output: Notes in Portuguese stating the breaking change and what users must do.
expectations: Output text is in Portuguese
The removal of the XML export is stated explicitly with the action required
Section structure (New Features / Improvements / Bug Fixes) is preserved
